newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound gains slightly against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound gains slightly against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound strengthened fractionally against the dollar on Sunday in a private sector market short of the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"The market is short of dollars," one banker said.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3870 and 3.3886 pounds bid, and at between 3.3910 and 3.3925 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate was 3.387525 pounds bid and 3.39175 pounds offered in the interbank market, compared to 3.388125 pounds bid and 3.3903787 pounds offered on Wednesday.
Banks were closed on Thursday for a public holiday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.386134 pounds buy and 3.391631 pounds sell.
